players.product: Capacitor-grade tantalum powder and tantalum wire (main raw materials for tantalum capacitors); also high-purity tantalum powder, tantalum ingots and 12-inch tantalum target blanks

quarterly_data.quarter: Ningxia Orient Tantalum results briefing Q&A: 2025 annual collective (05-18-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Management at the Ningxia listed companies' collective 2025 results briefing: CFO Li Ruiyun said the company produces to order and its output is currently fully utilised; VP and board secretary Qin Hongwu said its tantalum powder and tantalum wire, used mainly to make tantalum capacitors, keep quality and yield at an international advanced level (company view) with stable delivery, and that 23 informatization-industrialization integration projects went live in 2025, including a crucible stacking system for tantalum-powder heat treatment, a medium- and high-voltage smart screening system and an MES at the products plant. Chairman Huang Zhixue said domestic demand for superalloys, semiconductor tantalum targets and high-purity niobium is gradually rising, and that R&D focuses on high-voltage high-reliability tantalum powder, semiconductor targets and superconducting materials.
